flags.message: gemini-baseline's retrieval.md reports no retrieval beyond provisioned inputs, but the harness log records a metrics/statpack.md read and a topic-based fedcourts query with decided-before 2026-09-15. All call results are unobserved, so the query's success and returned content are unknown; this is a disclosure inconsistency, not evidence of outcome leakage or a defect in capture coverage. See gemini-baseline's evaluation.md.
